source: Crée un jeu de rôle (RP) dans une école hantée en vraie 3D stylisée. Les joueurs doivent survivre à un monstre qui apparaît à minuit tout en explorant des pièces cachées.\nIntègre des zones réservées aux membres VIP, une boutique pour acheter des objets de défense ou des lampes de poche colorées avec des Robux, et ajoute un système de renaissances (Rebirth). Rend le décor très détaillé, lumineux et ultra fluide. »

image_prompt.text: A central oversized gathering space in the school - a main hall or atrium - sized to hold a crowd of roleplayers without traffic jams
Highly detailed scenic spots through the school built as backdrops for roleplay scenes and screenshots
A distinct structure visible across the map - the school's clock tower or bell spire - so players can orient by sight
The school itself as enterable interior: classrooms, corridors, and the item shop players go inside
Hidden rooms concealed behind the school's ordinary walls for players to discover while exploring
Lounge areas reserved for VIP members, visibly set apart from the rest of the school

layout_placement.text: Where the monster enters at midnight and the corridors it patrols
Access-restricted volumes at the VIP lounge entrances that only VIP members may pass

notes: Mixed classification: the sentence is about a roleplay game, so Roleplay owns the shape and preset; Survival contributes the monster spawner only.
Shape fit is poor: every Roleplay shape is a housing or town model and this is one enterable school building. Static Settlement was the closest, with the school standing in for the town.
Genre note: this genre is P3 by default in practice, and the school interior makes that unavoidable here.
Rebirth, Robux purchases, and VIP entitlement are economy concerns with no layout representation beyond the gated zone.

open_questions.ask: Is surviving the midnight monster a round-based win or loss, or just an event that happens during open-ended roleplay?
Is the whole game inside the school building, or are there grounds and a schoolyard outside as well?
How large should the school be - a handful of rooms, or a full multi-wing campus?

theme: Stylized haunted school - bright, colourful and highly detailed rather than grim

coverage_missing.ask: Does the monster kill you and end a round, or is it a scare event inside a persistent roleplay world?
Interior-only school, or school plus exterior grounds?
What is inside the VIP areas - a lounge, better shop stock, a safe room?
How many rooms and floors should the school have?

answers.ask: Is surviving the midnight monster a round-based win or loss, or just an event that happens during open-ended roleplay?
answers.answer: C’est un événement de survie en manches : à minuit, le monstre apparaît et les joueurs doivent survivre pour gagner la manche.

answers.ask: Is the whole game inside the school building, or are there grounds and a schoolyard outside as well?
answers.answer: Le jeu se déroule principalement à l’intérieur de l’école, afin de concentrer l’exploration des salles cachées et l’ambiance hantée.

answers.ask: How large should the school be - a handful of rooms, or a full multi-wing campus?
answers.answer: Faites une petite école détaillée avec une poignée de salles, couloirs et pièces secrètes, plutôt qu’un vaste campus à plusieurs ailes.
